description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. Create and view this ID in the console. Only one ID is supported.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The per-user query-per-second (QPS) limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call this API responsibly.
